question: In which of the following Summer Olympics did Neeraj Chopra win the gold medal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2020**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Neeraj Chopra**, an Indian javelin thrower, won the **gold medal** in the **2020 Summer Olympics**, held in **Tokyo, Japan**. The event was conducted in **August 2021** due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• He achieved this historic feat in the **men's javelin throw final** on **7th August 2021**, with a best throw of **87.58 meters**.
 
• Neeraj Chopra’s gold medal was **India’s first-ever Olympic medal in athletics**, marking a historic moment in Indian sports history.
 
• His performance made him the **second Indian individual gold medalist** in Olympic history, after **Abhinav Bindra**, who won gold in shooting in **2008**.
